title: TomoClub | This is what screen time SHOULD look like | TAICY 2026 Reel
notes: a_in/a_out: the words, in seconds of the source recording, cut in the pauses between words (faster-whisper word timestamps checked against the audio energy).
v_in: the picture comes from that time instead (same round). Used for the hook (a live 3-way battle) and the Game 1 debrief, where the real screen shows a student's DEFEAT screen.
view: game = centre square of the screen share; vk / vedant / sudeep = that person's Zoom tile, cropped square (the crop leaves out the Zoom name label); grid = all three faces stacked.
head: the kinetic headline at the top. *word* is set in gold. A shot without head keeps the previous one.
The lights-off round shows the coach's view of the map, so the text says the lights were off for the kids.

shots.head: This is what screen time|*SHOULD* look like
shots.text: So this isn't like your PUBG or other games, right? This is more strategy and thinking game.

shots.head: No rules. *No answers.*
shots.text: We don't give you any rules.
You have to talk to each other and figure it out.

shots.head: They crack the rules…|*together.*
shots.text: In order to unlock the door, someone needs to be at this button over here.

shots.head: Level 1: *cleared.*
shots.text: Yep, level one!

shots.head: They split the roles.|*They plan.*
shots.text: Actually, I'll just be at the button, unlocking the doors you explore, through each door.
Okay, I got the last chip. Now we need to go to the platform.

shots.head: The coach asks.|*The kids think.*
shots.text: How are you doing it so fast?
Because we remember where all the circuit pieces are, and exactly
what we should do at which time.

shots.head: Now the lights go *OFF*|for the kids.
shots.text: Oh, I can't see any light.
But it's the same map. Can you remember?

shots.head: Same level.|Cleared in *45 seconds.*
shots.text: 45 seconds. You've completed it. Pretty cool.

shots.head: Stuck? That's where|*learning starts.*
shots.text: And I didn't understand what was happening.
No problem. That's the part of learning, right?

shots.head: Bounce back. *Every time.*
shots.text: You can always bounce back in this game, right? And Sudeep, I saw you doing it. So, good job.

shots.head: In their *own words.*
shots.text: Usually in other games you're competing against someone, but here you're actually working together for a certain goal.
Communication is key.

shots.head: Game-based learning,|*the TomoClub way.*
shots.text: So this is what game-based learning looks like.
And I'm so proud of you.
